original_targets.checks.py: global v0.9, transferred to v0.9.1 because its mathematical body was unchanged

adaption: A: retain only five global groups, wrap as functions; B: port unchanged formulas to sage -python, split jobs, stable IDs, enforce nonzero failure exits. Replace heuristic Weyl nonzero inference by its checked -1/3 component; normalize the derivative by the explicitly nonzero factor a*sinh(pi); label rank test as c=1 and c=0. Exclude local B/C/Q1-Q3 checks.
independence: A was authored using SymPy coordinate/algebra calculations; B was authored separately using SageMath manifold curvature and SR/ideal calculations. The frozen B execution record states that A was not reused. This is provenance of two authored routes, not independent formal certification.
prior_results_policy: No previous logs are represented as new runs. Distributed results are fresh executions of these adapted files. Original logs and private review discussions are not redistributed.
v092_compatibility: The relevant Section 3,6,8 and Appendix A formulas are unchanged from v0.9.1; v0.9.2 adds a reality lemma and refines rebasing/overlap admission, none of which is claimed to be proved by these checks.
gaussian_scope_change: The original stage2 used arbitrary functions of (t,x,y). The adapted diagonal arbitrary-function run hit the enforced 1,999,998,976-byte cap (OOMKilled=true); it was not retried at the same scale. The public run uses two explicit polynomial positive-definite spatial metrics instead, with the same Gaussian/Bianchi identity code. This narrows the input scope; original general-family results are not adopted as new outputs.
standalone_extraction: Restore the original dot helper, spatial-normal metric mt and polzero helper in their standalone modules; no local-paper B/C checks are imported. Wrapper/reporting changes are separate from mathematical formulas.

rc2_integration.source_review: Constant spatial normalization, independent symmetric derivative jets, inverse/connection/Ricci derivatives, residual versus direct Bianchi, and non-circularity were checked against Proposition A.2 before integration.
rc2_integration.changes: No correction to tested mathematical identities. Name covariant zeroth-order metric g0 separately from inverse gi; add container input-domain/Ricci-symmetry diagnostics; hash every executed main/helper before import and record complete dependencies.
rc2_integration.old_results: 57 rc.1 checks, all associated runtime/code/input files and 14 hD/hO checks retained byte-for-byte; no claim of a new execution for these records.
rc2_integration.new_results: 11 universal-jet checks freshly executed as three rc.2 jobs; both drivers have an actual intentional false-check exit-1 probe.
rc2_integration.implementation_relationship: The direct 3jet code shares the 2jet helper; they are complementary calculations, not independent implementations. The Sage metric cases remain a different implementation route.
rc2_integration.publication: Unpublished; no GitHub/Zenodo operation; licence status unchanged.

release_binding.executed_payload_policy: All calculation/runtime/input/result files are byte-identical to rc.2; only host package validation, indexes, citations, mapping and documentation change.
